description: This file contains functions for managing UBUS context, invoking UBUS methods synchronously and asynchronously, and sending UBUS events, specifically for the bbfdm API.

methods.name: int bbfdm_init_ubus_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Initializes the UBUS context within a given bbfdm context structure by establishing a connection.

methods.name: int bbfdm_free_ubus_ctx(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx)
methods.description: Frees the UBUS context associated with the bbfdm context structure.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_invoke_sync(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * msg,int timeout,bbfdm_ubus_cb data_callback,void * callback_args)
methods.description: Performs a synchronous UBUS invocation with specified object, method, and message, with a callback for handling responses.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_invoke_async(struct ubus_context * ubus_ctx,const char * obj,const char * method,struct blob_attr * msg,bbfdm_ubus_cb data_callback,bbfdm_ubus_async_cb complete_callback)
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous UBUS invocation, setting up callbacks for response and completion.

methods.name: int bbfdm_ubus_send_event(struct bbfdm_ctx * bbfdm_ctx,const char * obj,struct blob_attr * msg)
methods.description: Sends a UBUS event to observers.
